messages:
sam: Quick kickoff 1: we're shipping the latency benchmark + companion launch post + webinar. Need an SEO checklist: canonicalization, redirects for old benchmarks, JSON-LD (Event + FAQ + Breadcrumb), internal-link funnel map, and inbound lead routing to HubSpot. Who takes what?

anya: I can own structured data. I want Event + FAQ + BreadcrumbList. Also we'll need OG/Twitter card meta and alt text for hero.

leo: I'll handle redirects and canonical headers. plan: 301 for permanent moves, 302 for temporary, leave anchor-preserving redirects. Drop CSV in shared drive and request staging deploy.

marta: I'll design the internal link map: landing -> bench -> deep-dive -> docs -> demo. Add CTA anchors: #signup-top, #signup-mid, #signup-end. Also will change H2s to include the primary keyword `low latency inference`.

seo-bot: crawl_findings: missing canonical on /benchmarks/latency-v1, schema missing startDate on /webinars/latency-live, 4 broken internal links referencing /docs/old-bench.

sam: Leo, include these in the redirect CSV: `/benchmarks/latency-old` -> `/benchmark/latency-2026` (301), `/webinars/latency-old` -> `/webinars/latency-2026` (302 until 2026-06-01).

leo: Got it. Example nginx snippet I'll deploy to staging: 
```nginx
location = /benchmarks/latency-old {
  return 301 https://redwood.ai/benchmark/latency-2026$request_uri;
}
```
This preserves query strings.

anya: JSON-LD example I'll server-render on the webinar page: 
```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Low-latency Inference: Benchmark & Tuning","startDate":"2026-06-10T18:00:00Z","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinars/latency-2026"}
```
Also FAQ markup for signup Qs.

marta: For internal linking, I'll add contextual links in the methodology section and a sidebar promo linking to the webinar. Also include rel=canonical pointing to the master benchmark page for derivatives.

sam: Analytics/routing: add hidden form field `campaign=latency_launch` and GTM event `latency_webinar_signup`. HubSpot workflow should tag source and route to `webinar-inbound` queue.

leo: I'll push the redirects tonight to staging and ping when the sitemap is regenerated. Will also set 410 for retired experimental pages.

seo-bot: action_items: update sitemap.xml to include /benchmark/latency-2026, run Rich Results test after deploy, monitor Search Console for coverage and enhancements.

anya: Reminder: JSON-LD must be server-side so Search Console picks it up. If any page is client-rendered, we need prerender or SSR.

sam: Timeline: redirect CSV + staging by Fri, schema SSR by Mon, OG images + preload by Tue, routing + GA4 setup Wed. QA session Thu 9am PT.

marta: I'll update the editorial doc with anchor IDs and share the link.

sam: Thanks team 1: will finalize copy and push draft link here when ready.

leo: Deployed staging redirects, posted CSV: https://drive.redwood.com/seo/latency-redirects-193212.csv

anya: After staging, I'll run structured data validator and report back.

sam: Closing loop 1: after launch we'll do a postmortem check: redirects, rich snippets, and attribution accuracy. :rocket:
